notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[p]We’ve just released a major update to our demo! Here's what’s new:[/p][p][b]All-New Protagonist Animations[/b] – Every animation has been reworked for a smoother and more dynamic experience.[/p][p]
[b]New Enemies & a Fearsome Boss[/b] – Face fresh challenges with newly added enemies and an epic new boss battle![/p][p]
[b]Upgrade Shop Added[/b] – Collect resources and spend them on powerful upgrades in our brand-new shop system.[/p][p]
[b]Complete UI Overhaul[/b] – The entire user interface has been redesigned to be more intuitive and polished.[/p][p]
[b]Refined Combat System[/b] – We’ve fine-tuned the combat mechanics for a more responsive and satisfying experience.[/p][p]Jump back in and explore the enhanced demo—your feedback is more valuable than ever![/p]
